full_judgment: Amirul Kabir Chowdhury J : At the instance of the State, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Comilla this appeal by leave has been preferred challenging the judgment and order dated 12.11.2002 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8895 of 2002 making the rule absolute thereby allowing bail to the accused respondents (1) Md. Kamaluddin @ Pichi Kamal, (2) Habibur Rahman and (3) Moqbul @ Moqbul Hossain in Muradnagar Police Station Case No.4 dated 05.05.2002 under Sections 143/326 of the Penal Code read with Sections 3, 4 and 6 of the explosive substantive Act.
